INSERT INTO portfolio_summaries (
                account_type,
                customer_type,
                account_capabilities,
                base_currency,
                account_name,
                statement_period,
                generated_at,
                statement_title,
                broker_name,
                broker_address,
                market_value,
                cost_basis,
                unrealized_pl,
                unrealized_pl_percent,
                total_positions
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
